Method of Attack: Malicious JavaScript code embedded in the user interface to capture and send private deposit notes to an unauthorized external server
Impacted Systems: Tornado Cash servers deployed on the IPFS network
Users accessing Tornado Cash through IPFS gateways like ipfs.io and cf-ipfs.com
Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via a deceptive governance proposal embedding malicious code
Indicators of Compromise: Encoded private deposit notes sent to an external server
